title: Q13
description:
Read: Psa 102:12-28, Isa 51:16

The psalm is an afflicted man praying that Zion be built, and that a people yet to be created will praise. The other text plants the heavens and founds the earth in order to say to Zion, you are my people.

a) The creator lines are put on the Son. What does the rest of the psalm, the afflicted man and Zion, then require of Him?

b) If the planting of the heavens is for the sake of saying "you are my people," what foundation is in view?
